summary: Radar for 2026-10-16. The biggest new event is that the EU's drug committee (CHMP) backed orforglipron (Foundayo) on Oct 16. It's a named next-gen pill and early in the news cycle, so it's our best Short and long-form slot this week. Gray-market stories are piling up: Bloomberg reports FDA inspection problems (mold, insects) at Chinese plants that supply GLP-1 compounding ingredients; Medscape covered a Penn Reddit/AI preprint on what bootleg retatrutide users report; and the AJC, Gizmodo and Lilly lawsuits all cover the black market. That's our proven calm 'what's confirmed vs not' lane: no sellers, always point to a prescriber. Head-to-head and muscle content on tirzepatide is still the most reliable on YouTube, and 'tirzepatide vs semaglutide 2026' search pages keep appearing in Google News. Smaller items: Fractyl's REMAIN-1 pivotal data (Oct 16) brings back the question of weight regain after stopping tirzepatide; 'GLP-1 supplements' myth-busting is rising in consumer outlets; Wegovy pill vs shot keeps getting coverage. Avoid or limit: eye-stroke (NAION) scare framing, the NYT anorexia story and compounded telehealth pricing. Verification notes: the CHMP opinion is confirmed. The Penn study is a medRxiv preprint (not yet peer-reviewed). Walmart's free GLP-1s are for type 2 diabetes only and start in 2027. Teva's Weltruza is an olanzapine injection for schizophrenia, not a GLP-1, so I dropped it. I couldn't confirm 'poison-center exposures nearly doubled' from a primary source.

candidates.topic: Orforglipron (Foundayo) recommended for EU approval: the EU drug committee (CHMP) backed Lilly's once-daily non-peptide GLP-1 pill on Oct 16, 2026 for weight management and type 2 diabetes in adults
candidates.angle: Short: 'Orforglipron just got an EU green light. How is this GLP-1 pill different?' Give the answer by 10 s: it's a small-molecule pill that, per EMA, can be taken any time of day without food or water restrictions. EMA summary: about 5-11% weight loss depending on dose vs about 2-2.5% on placebo at 72 weeks, in adults with obesity or overweight. Status line: CHMP recommendation Oct 16, 2026, final European Commission decision pending. Long-form option: 'Did orforglipron beat the Wegovy pill? What the trials show', dated and attributed to EMA and Lilly.
candidates.predicted_peak: 3-10 days (EU Commission decision expected within weeks)
candidates.why_now: The CHMP opinion was announced today, Medscape published 'What to know about orforglipron' today, and Fierce's oral GLP-1 tracker is running. Named next-gen drug decoders are our only long-forms that travel, and pill explainers have done well on both platforms.

candidates.topic: Why a 'research peptide' isn't the trial drug: Penn researchers used AI on Reddit posts from people who say they took bootleg retatrutide (13,589 users). The most-reported symptoms differed from the Phase 2 trial (medRxiv preprint, Medscape Oct 15)
candidates.angle: Calm decoder: 'People on bootleg retatrutide report different side effects than the trial. Here's what that does and doesn't mean.' Self-reported Reddit posts list appetite increase, fatigue, insomnia and fast heart rate among the most-reported symptoms, while the trial's were mostly stomach-related. The contents of unregulated vials are unknown. FDA has received 2 death reports (CBS, Oct 13). Retatrutide is investigational as of Oct 2026. Never name sellers. Point to a prescriber and approved options.

candidates.angle: Friendly myth-buster: 'GLP-1 supplements vs GLP-1 medicines: what's the difference?'
